page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs derived from 4 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The system is equipped with 64.0 GB of RAM, providing a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates that the processor delivers modest compute capabilities, with stress-ng single-core and multi-core performance falling into the bottom 25%. Similarly, single-threaded compression tasks, such as gzip and bzip3, register in the bottom 10%. However, the memory subsystem shows average performance in large-block read and write operations, though small-block cached reads remain in the bottom 25%. Database operations, represented by Redis SET benchmarks, achieve an average tier of 5.94 million operations per second.

The primary tradeoff of the ecs.se1.2xlarge is its high memory capacity relative to its compute performance. While the 64.0 GB RAM allocation supports memory-intensive workloads, the lower-tier CPU performance limits its effectiveness for compute-heavy tasks like medium-scale LLM inference or intensive software compilation. This profile is suitable for memory-optimized workloads that do not require high-frequency CPU cycles, such as caching layers, small-to-medium database deployments, and memory-bound general-purpose applications.
